failure_policy: First preparation failure/timeout stops permanently. First HDL child failure/timeout marks all later children NOT_RUN and preserves raw streams, receipt, original sources and failed text-vvp artifacts; no automatic retry or source repair.
forbidden: old package or shared document edits

hdl_matrix.order: Four TB compiles, example, N0/N65/W1/W25/T0/T33 rejections, then p0..p3 each main0/main1/reset.

known_timescale_metadata.scope: Fixed -Wno-timescale on existing five positive compile children; unchanged RTL has no timescale, TB does; all other diagnostics terminal; no child count/parameter/input change

n1_exclusion_proof: N1 has no partial index1, no nonlast or retired-prefix computation. For positive M, k=1 and k*x-(x-M)=M>0; no strict/equality deletion, no dropping pass and no later pass. M0 skips passes.
only_argv_substitution: After root approval replace the final placeholder with this file's exact SHA256.
oracle_primary: Independent descending sort and largest strict admissible prefix. Exact Python integer / Fraction KKT, nonnegativity and mass=M certificates; no active-set output oracle.
oracle_secondary: For each of the 44 named N<=3 main inputs and their 58 owner/fresh reset inputs, enumerate mathematical nonempty positive supports only. No extra input vectors.
outputs: Exactly fixtures/p0..p3_main.txt, fixtures/p0..p3_reset.txt, fixtures/p0..p3.json and PREPARED.json. TEST_PLAN.json stays immutable.

preauthor_raw_byte_protection.scope: Only .gitattributes raw preparation/reports/artifacts/failure/history byte protection; all mathematical sources, raw input definitions and TEST_PLAN unchanged

preauthor_raw_log_relations.scope: Require every actual simulation line or exact normal finish; empty simulation stderr; read-only check rebinds planned argv/rc/time/raw streams/results; child discrepancy status FAIL; no RTL/oracle/fixture/TEST_PLAN changes

preexecution_revision_20261105.scope: Preserve original LICENSE bytes; pre-resume deadline and terminal timeout classification; B strict summary/receipt relationships only where applicable; no mathematical/stimulus changes

preparation_supervision: Root launches exactly once, with a hard 20-second process-tree deadline. Failure/timeout preserves partial inputs/stdout/stderr/receipt, is terminal, and forbids retry.

profile_specs.inputs: 12 explicit named single-value/mass pairs in prepare.py; no product enumeration.
profile_specs.name: p0

profile_specs.inputs: 32 explicit named triples/mass pairs in prepare.py; k1/k2/k3, threshold equality, negative and max unsigned mass.
profile_specs.name: p1

profile_specs.inputs: 28 fixed structural definitions in prepare.py; no random seed, adaptive substitution or deduplication.
profile_specs.name: p2

profile_specs.inputs: Same 28 fixed named structural definitions evaluated at maximum legal parameters.
profile_specs.name: p3

qualification_stage: Root must inspect generated certificates/fixture hashes and approve a separate SOURCE_FREEZE before any compiler/simulator. This plan grants no HDL authorization.
reset_fresh: All zero samples, unsigned mass 2^W-1, owner tag XOR full TAG mask. Vector and tag differ; every fresh frame is fully certified and retired.
reset_owner: Fixed analytical [min] for N1 or [2,1,-2,...,-2] for N>1. M=0 only for initialize_zero; M=1 otherwise. Never choose an owner by candidate search.
reset_witness: Separate control_walk.py freezes live state/index/prefix/k/round/sum/threshold/kept/bitmap/read/product predicates; oracle.py supplies every output. Non-live fields are masked/canonical zero.
